## What

Breadboard what the KV260 cannot prove, driven by Nucleo firmware v0:

- the MCU
- load switches: soft-start and current-limit trip
- the SOM power-enable sequence

## Done when

- [ ] Inrush, trip point and sequencing **measured on the bench**, with scope
      captures in `hardware/bench/`.
- [ ] Any part swaps made and reflected in the BOM.

## Notes

These results feed directly into the B2.4 schematic review. Do not let B2.4
pass review on datasheet values alone.
